title: POV: monsoon hits a 90s Indian village 🌧️❤️ #shorts

segments.moment_description: The monsoon breaks over the village - lightning, rain streaming off the tiled roof, Radha dashes across the courtyard
On the veranda they light the wood chulha together, coaxing the fire alive as the rain falls behind them
Golden poori puff up in the hot kadai - the smell of a rainy-day kitchen
Radha serves the hot meal, the little one runs in, warmth all around while it pours outside
He feeds her the first bite in the rain - a quiet, happy monsoon moment together
